headline: Fierce Clashes Shake Nevish Line as Kuura Strand Ignites
war_summary: Warden counter-efforts in Nevish Line have consolidated their hold at six strategic redoubts to two Colonial, even as furious close-quarters action continues along Blackcoat Way. Across the northern snows, Weathered Expanse endures as the theater's deadliest bloodbath, logging over six thousand combined casualties in the last two hours amid uninterrupted fighting at Crow's Nest and Wightwalk. In Stlican Shelf, heavy attrition persists around Fort Hoarfrost and Breaker Town, leaving one strongpoint contested in no-man's-land. A sudden flare-up has ignited in Kuura Strand, where repeated clashes over Talven stripped Warden possession and created fresh no-man's-land within the hour. Maritime skirmishing also reached Fisherman's Row, where Black Well saw rapid changes of hands, while Palantine Berm logged renewed combat near Leiri Hermanni. Farther south, massive casualty rates in Mooring County and Callahan's Passage sustained ferocious butcher's bills without yielding further shifts in base control.
